tasks.title: Welcome to novl-dashboard
tasks.description: Drag me between columns. Edit me. Assign me.

tasks.title: Protect Jarvis-board main branch
tasks.description: Enable branch protection rules on OrazioP26/Jarvis-board (require PRs + status checks once workflows exist; block force-push; require signed commits if desired).

tasks.title: Review Novl-desktop collaborators
tasks.description: Confirm anthonytast + Markus112105 still need push access; reduce to least-privilege (triage/pull) if possible.

tasks.title: Enable security scanning where possible
tasks.description: Enable Dependabot alerts / dependency graph; consider GitHub Advanced Security or making relevant repos public if acceptable; set up CodeQL + secret scanning for supported repos.

tasks.title: Update dev tooling to address npm audit warnings
tasks.description: In novl-dashboard: upgrade vitest (major bump suggested) and ensure vite/esbuild versions patched; re-run npm audit.

tasks.title: Harden Clawdbot secrets handling
tasks.description: Ensure ~/.clawdbot/clawdbot.json has restrictive permissions (600). Consider moving API keys to 1Password/env injection or macOS Keychain; rotate Telegram bot token + OpenAI keys if exposure suspected.

tasks.title: Add CI workflow (lint + build) to Jarvis-board
tasks.description: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml to run on PRs + main: npm ci, npm run lint, npm run build. This enables branch protection to require status checks.

tasks.title: Add Dependabot for npm + GitHub Actions (Jarvis-board)
tasks.description: Create .github/dependabot.yml for npm (weekly) + github-actions (weekly). Enable dependency graph/alerts in repo settings if not already.
